name: ac-distressed-and-restructuring
description: Working a distressed capital structure from claim to recovery: the priority waterfall and absolute priority, fulcrum security determination, out-of-court exchange versus chapter 11, DIP financing and priming, automatic stay effects, claims trading and the trading desk, plan mechanics and cramdown, and the written restructuring record. It explains the process and the recovery arithmetic; it never recommends a distressed security and never predicts a court outcome. Use when asking "chapter 11", "DIP financing", "fulcrum security", "cramdown", "absolute priority", "claims trading", "recovery waterfall", "whose debt is money good", "distressed exchange", "plan of reorganisation". Not for assessing an issuer's ordinary credit quality (ac-bank-and-credit-analysis), not for bond spread and duration mechanics (ac-fixed-income-and-rates), not for convertible specific structure (ac-convertible-and-hybrid-capital).
